title: Lazy Sequences: NumberRange and even_numbers
instructions: Implement `NumberRange` in `main/iterators.py` and the generator function `even_numbers` in `main/generators.py`. `NumberRange(start, end)` inherits from the provided abstract `LazySequence` (`main/base.py`, do not edit) and is its own iterator over `start` up to but excluding `end`. `even_numbers(limit)` yields 0, 2, 4, ... below `limit`. Neither may build a list, and both validate their input with the exact exceptions from the requirements.

evidence.label: NumberRange yields start up to but not including end
NumberRange is a LazySequence and its own iterator
NumberRange is exhausted after one loop
NumberRange is lazy for huge ranges
Rejects non-integer bounds (including bool) with TypeError
even_numbers yields evens below the limit
even_numbers is a lazy generator function
even_numbers rejects non-integer limits with TypeError
even_numbers rejects a negative limit with ValueError
